## Bash-colored commands

Language tags affect styling, not execution.

```bash markmason
mm-test-cli echo "first"
mm-test-cli echo "second"
```

```expected
first
second
```

## Python-colored commands

```python markmason
mm-test-cli echo "python"
```

```expected
python
```

## C#-colored commands

```csharp markmason
mm-test-cli echo "csharp"
```

```expected
csharp
```
